title: Tox21 multi-endpoint toxicity prediction: a reproducible research and inference artifact
description: Reproducible research artifact for 12-endpoint toxicity prediction on the public Tox21 dataset: data provenance and dual-version audit, pre-registered protocol, Murcko-scaffold frozen evaluation (LightGBM + ECFP4, macro ROC-AUC 0.7003 on the scaffold test split; random-split control 0.807 +/- 0.010), independent audit and revision records, a security-audited FastAPI inference service, Docker image (non-root), 84 tests, and an artifact integrity verifier. All headline numbers are recomputable from the frozen git artifacts (see reports/final/reproducibility.md).
notes: DOI intentionally pending until Zenodo deposition; CITATION.cff in the repository carries the placeholder and is updated at deposition time.
